customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned in workflow env vars (gitleaks, uv): a `# renovate:` comment line followed by NAME_VERSION: x.y.z (no leading v). A gitleaks bump also needs GITLEAKS_SHA256 updated by hand; until then the checksum step fails closed.

horae-sdk from the core repository's main, pinned to a commit in [tool.uv.sources] until it is on PyPI (then delete this manager). Run `uv lock` on the pull request: the Lockfile check fails until uv.lock follows the new rev.

packageRules.description: A git commit has no release timestamp, so the 7-day age cannot apply: bump the core pin weekly instead, and review it like any dependency.
